groups.name: cold/warm detached copies
groups.oracle: Real separate SQLite store; compare all outer metadata and selected ACL with full snapshot; mutate returned copies; later observations and full graph unchanged.

groups.name: explicit projection boundary
groups.oracle: Unrelated business getter excluded without invocation; existing full reader still refuses it; no durable change.

groups.name: malformed projection inputs
groups.oracle: Own data/roleMap/access and nested object accessors, selected cycle, data symbol/prototype, outer invalid version and audit accessor refused without getter invocation or commit.

groups.name: authority equivalence and older-adapter fallback
groups.oracle: Real principal/access revision equality, both full sets of three authenticate calls, preserved receiver, legacy full method selected only when capability absent.

groups.name: present undefined fails closed
groups.oracle: Valid full root exists; optional method present returns undefined; actual UI admission denied and full fallback call count remains zero.

groups.name: canonical role/access semantics
groups.oracle: Invalid persisted role map and invalid assigned scope are denied by real ProductAuthority, then normal admission succeeds after rollback.

groups.name: mutable-root ACL and lease
groups.oracle: Planner ACL/roles changed in actual mutable root; new projection sees change and prior UI lease loses authority; rollback restores original access revision.

groups.name: final C08 authorization
groups.oracle: Callback observes actual protected preference; ACL changes before final authorize; C08 returns denied without protected value and performs both three-surface observations.

groups.name: final private lease
groups.oracle: Lease is finished during authentication; real UI revalidator checks current lease after await and refuses; later new lease works.

groups.name: abort and expiry
groups.oracle: Root signal cancellation rejects synchronous projection and final root; private request invalidated; clock-expired lease denied without reauth.

groups.name: scope lifetime and isolation
groups.oracle: Late descendant of ended root cannot borrow current later root; second store has no access scope from first store ALS.

groups.name: fresh next-root SQL
groups.oracle: Actual peer writer stays pending outside held BEGIN IMMEDIATE; after release and committed write the next root sees new ACL and old lease is denied.

groups.name: installed wrapper forwarding
groups.oracle: Actual CurrentChoiceFence + SourcePersistence spread preserves optional projection and complete original reader, then actual ProductAuthority admits through composed persistence.
